package rulefixtures

import (
	"errors"
	"log"
	"os"
)

// scenario for error_logged_and_returned: `log.Error(err); return err` or `logger.Error("failed", zap.Error(err)); return fmt.Errorf("failed: %w", err)` - logging the error then returning it
// fixture polarity: positive; family: library; severity: info.
func scenario409Positive(path string) ([]byte, error) {
	data, err := os.ReadFile(path)
	if err != nil {
		log.Printf("error reading file: %v", err)
		return nil, err
	}
	if len(data) == 0 {
		err := errors.New("file is empty")
		log.Printf("error: %v", err)
		return nil, err
	}
	return data, nil
}
